description: Review semantic Maven POM edits before execution with two read-only security agents.

hooks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy; root=next(p for p in (Path.cwd(),*Path.cwd().parents) if (p/'.git').exists()); runpy.run_path(str(root/'.codex/hooks/launch.py'),run_name='__main__')"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking POM changes and dependency security
